measures.name: Benchmark Sales Revenue (Legacy)
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM(factsales[NetSalesSignedUSD]), REMOVEFILTERS(), FILTER(ALL(dimdate), dimdate[CalendarDate] >= DATE(2026,9,1) && dimdate[CalendarDate] < DATE(2026,10,1)), dimchannel[ChannelName] = "Online", factsales[EventType] = "Sale")
measures.description: Fixed September 2026 Online benchmark calculated from live signed transactions. Removes report filters, then applies identical benchmark dates/channel. No hardcoded revenue.

measures.name: Benchmark Revenue Difference

measures.name: Monthly Sales Revenue (Chart)
measures.expression: VAR AxisDate = MAX(dimdate[CalendarDate]) VAR MonthStart = DATE(YEAR(AxisDate), MONTH(AxisDate), 1) VAR MonthEnd = EOMONTH(AxisDate, 0) VAR SelectedMonthDates = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dimdate[CalendarDate]), dimdate[CalendarDate] >= MonthStart && dimdate[CalendarDate] <= MonthEnd) VAR AnchorDate = MINX(SelectedMonthDates, dimdate[CalendarDate]) RETURN IF(AxisDate = AnchorDate, CALCULATE(SUM(factsales[NetSalesSignedUSD]), SelectedMonthDates, KEEPFILTERS(factsales[EventType] = "Sale")))
measures.description: Chart-only monthly total on the first selected date of each month. Preserves external date, channel and brand selections; includes Sale events only. Other daily axis points return BLANK. KPI logic is unchanged.

measures.name: Monthly Order Value (Chart)
measures.expression: VAR AxisDate = MAX(dimdate[CalendarDate]) VAR MonthStart = DATE(YEAR(AxisDate), MONTH(AxisDate), 1) VAR MonthEnd = EOMONTH(AxisDate, 0) VAR SelectedMonthDates = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dimdate[CalendarDate]), dimdate[CalendarDate] >= MonthStart && dimdate[CalendarDate] <= MonthEnd) VAR AnchorDate = MINX(SelectedMonthDates, dimdate[CalendarDate]) RETURN IF(AxisDate = AnchorDate, CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(factsales[NetSalesSignedUSD]), KEEPFILTERS(factsales[EventType] = "Sale")), CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(factsales[OrderID]), KEEPFILTERS(factsales[EventType] = "Sale"))), SelectedMonthDates))
measures.description: Chart-only monthly ratio of totals; one point per selected month. Preserves date, year, brand and channel selections; Sale events only.

measures.name: Monthly Basket Size (Chart)
measures.expression: VAR AxisDate = MAX(dimdate[CalendarDate]) VAR MonthStart = DATE(YEAR(AxisDate), MONTH(AxisDate), 1) VAR MonthEnd = EOMONTH(AxisDate, 0) VAR SelectedMonthDates = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dimdate[CalendarDate]), dimdate[CalendarDate] >= MonthStart && dimdate[CalendarDate] <= MonthEnd) VAR AnchorDate = MINX(SelectedMonthDates, dimdate[CalendarDate]) RETURN IF(AxisDate = AnchorDate, CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(factsales[QuantitySigned]), KEEPFILTERS(factsales[EventType] = "Sale")), CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(factsales[OrderID]), KEEPFILTERS(factsales[EventType] = "Sale"))), SelectedMonthDates))
measures.description: Chart-only monthly ratio of totals; one point per selected month. Preserves date, year, brand and channel selections; Sale events only.
